* Create high-quality AI-generated videos for luxury real estate projects.

jobs.title: Creative Director & Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

**Billionaire Collections** is a Dubai-based luxury retail company specialising in exclusive luxury smartphones, premium watches, and high-end lifestyle accessories. With an established presence in the luxury market and international brand partnerships, we bring together some of the world's most distinguished names in luxury and innovation. Our focus is on exceptional products, refined customer experiences, and delivering excellence to a discerning international clientele.

**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Marketing & Brand Development

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, creative, and commercially focused **Creative Director & Digital Marketing Manager** to lead our brand's digital presence, creative production, and marketing growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong creative vision with practical digital marketing expertise. You should understand how to develop compelling video concepts, build premium brand experiences, manage social media platforms, and execute performance-driven advertising campaigns that generate genuine customer interest and business opportunities.

This is a leadership position for someone who understands both the creative and commercial sides of marketing. You will oversee our in-house content creation team, work closely with photographers, videographers, editors, and designers, and take responsibility for developing campaigns that strengthen brand identity, expand audience reach, generate qualified leads, and increase sales.

Experience in luxury retail, premium lifestyle products, high-end accessories, or luxury technology brands will be a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Campaign Development

* Develop original creative concepts for digital campaigns, brand storytelling, product launches, and social media content.
* Introduce fresh video formats, engaging content series, and distinctive campaign ideas that differentiate the brand from competitors.
* Lead the creative process from initial concept and scripting through production, editing, approval, and publication.
* Create compelling video hooks, scripts, captions, headlines, and on-screen messaging.
* Establish a consistent visual identity and premium creative standard across all marketing channels.
* Identify relevant social media trends and transform them into brand-appropriate creative opportunities.
* Ensure every campaign communicates the brand's positioning, product value, and exclusivity.

2. Digital Advertising & Performance Marketing

* Plan, execute, and manage advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads.
* Develop strategies focused on brand awareness, customer acquisition, website visits, qualified inquiries, and sales conversions.
* Research and segment audiences based on customer interests, purchasing behaviour, and market opportunities.
* Manage advertising expenditure and optimize campaigns to improve cost per lead, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* Conduct A/B testing across creatives, advertisements, audiences, and campaign formats.
* Develop retargeting campaigns to convert previous website visitors, social media users, and interested prospects into customers.
* Monitor campaign performance and prepare actionable reports for management.

3. Brand Development & Marketing Strategy

* Build and execute marketing plans that support long-term brand growth and commercial objectives.
* Develop strategies that strengthen brand awareness, reputation, customer confidence, and market positioning.
* Plan promotional activities, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand awareness initiatives.
* Identify new opportunities to reach high-value customers and expand market presence.
* Maintain a consistent luxury identity across websites, social media, advertisements, and other digital touchpoints.
* Work with management to align marketing activities with sales objectives and business priorities.

4. Social Media & Digital Content Management

* Oversee the brand's presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Develop and manage monthly and weekly content calendars.
* Direct the creation of Reels, short-form videos, product photography, promotional graphics, Stories, and campaign materials.
* Ensure regular publishing and maintain high standards of content quality.
* Monitor audience engagement, comments, direct messages, and customer feedback.
* Identify potential buyers through social media interactions and coordinate with the sales department for timely follow-up.
* Build meaningful audience relationships and encourage genuine product interest rather than focusing only on views and follower numbers.

5. Creative Production & Team Leadership

* Lead and supervise the in-house content creation team, including photographers, videographers, editors, and designers.
* Assign responsibilities, establish production schedules, and ensure timely completion of creative projects.
* Prepare clear creative briefs with concepts, references, deliverables, and production requirements.
* Direct photoshoots, video productions, editing styles, and visual presentations.
* Review and approve content before publication to ensure consistency and quality.
* Manage relationships with freelance creatives and external production partners.
* Encourage creative innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement within the team.

6. Website, UX & Digital Experience

* Oversee the visual presentation and creative direction of company websites and digital platforms.
* Work with web developers and designers to improve website layouts, landing pages, product presentations, and user journeys.
* Understand the fundamentals of user experience (UX), user interface (UI), and conversion-focused design.
* Recommend improvements to website functionality, navigation, content structure, and customer experience.

jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING! Marketing & Brand Strategy Manager Creditcare Credit Management | UAE

**Job Location:** United Arab Emirates  
**Salary:** Up to AED 5,000 per month  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 3 years of relevant UAE experience  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Creditcare Credit Management LLC

Creditcare Credit Management is looking for a dynamic, creative and commercially focused Marketing & Brand Strategy Manager to lead our marketing initiatives, strengthen our corporate identity and increase our brand visibility in the UAE market.

The ideal candidate must have a strong understanding of the UAE business environment, local market trends, customer behaviour and competitive landscape. We are looking for someone who can think strategically while also being actively involved in the execution of marketing campaigns, brand development and business growth initiatives.

Candidates with experience in financial services, credit management, debt collection, banking, financial consultancy or B2B services will have an added advantage.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Marketing Strategy & Planning

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.
* Identify target audiences and develop effective strategies to reach potential clients.
* Research UAE market trends, customer preferences and competitor activities.
* Identify new business opportunities and marketing channels within the UAE.
* Develop strategies to improve brand awareness, market penetration and customer engagement.
* Ensure all marketing activities support the company's overall growth objectives.

2. Brand Management & Corporate Identity

* Develop and maintain a strong and consistent corporate brand identity for Creditcare Credit Management.
* Create brand positioning strategies to differentiate the company from competitors.
* Ensure consistent brand messaging across all marketing platforms and communication channels.
* Manage corporate presentations, company profiles, brochures, promotional materials and marketing collateral.
* Develop professional branding strategies to enhance the company's credibility and reputation.
* Work on improving the company's visibility and positioning within the UAE financial and corporate sectors.

3. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

* Plan, develop and manage social media marketing strategies.
* Manage company social media accounts, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and other relevant platforms.
* Develop engaging and professional content, including posts, campaigns, videos and promotional creatives.
* Plan and execute paid advertising campaigns where appropriate.
* Manage digital marketing activities to increase brand reach, engagement and qualified business enquiries.
* Monitor social media performance, campaign analytics and audience engagement.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, content creators and external marketing agencies when required.
* Maintain a consistent and professional online presence.

4. UAE Market Research & Business Development Support

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of the UAE business environment and local market dynamics.
* Identify potential corporate clients, business sectors and strategic market opportunities.
* Conduct competitor analysis and evaluate industry marketing practices.
* Understand the requirements of UAE-based businesses and develop relevant marketing approaches.
* Support business development activities through targeted marketing campaigns.
* Build brand awareness among corporate clients, financial institutions, SMEs and other relevant business segments.
* Identify potential partnerships, networking opportunities and industry events.

5. Content Creation & Marketing Communication

* Develop professional marketing content for websites, social media, email campaigns and corporate communications.
* Prepare marketing presentations, proposals, company profiles and promotional materials.
* Ensure all communication reflects the company's professional image and brand values.
* Coordinate with internal departments to understand business requirements and develop suitable marketing messages.
* Maintain a consistent tone of voice across all marketing communications.
* Develop informative and educational content relevant to credit management and financial services.

6. Campaign Management & Performance Monitoring

* Plan, execute and monitor marketing campaigns from concept to completion.
* Establish marketing objectives, budgets and measurable performance indicators.
* Track campaign results, lead generation, engagement and conversion performance.
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports for management.
* Analyse campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Manage marketing budgets efficiently and ensure optimum return on investment.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing performance.

Mandatory Candidate Requirements

* Minimum 3 years of relevant marketing experience in the UAE.
* Strong and practical knowledge of the UAE market is mandatory.
* Proven experience in marketing strategy and brand management.
* Good understanding of UAE customer behaviour and business culture.
* Experience managing corporate branding and digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong knowledge of LinkedIn and other social media marketing platforms.
* Understanding of lead generation, marketing analytics and campaign management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong creative thinking, planning and organisational abilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple marketing activities.
* Must be proactive, result-oriented and commercially aware.

Preferred Industry Experience

Preference will be given to candidates who have previously worked in:

* Financial Services
* Banking and Financial Consultancy
* Corporate B2B Services
* Business Consultancy and Professional Services

jobs.title: Head of Brand Partnerships- Middle East & Africa
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet the team**  
We know the impact experiences have on lasting memories. That's why, we help brands connect in a meaningful way with their audience through culturally resonant campaigns.

Operating like a creative agency, our team uses their expertise in entertainment and immersive events to help brands and agencies across the globe **conceptualize, produce, and manage multi-channel campaigns** that give audiences experiences they will remember.

We craft **bespoke strategies** that blend branded content, digital storytelling, ticketed experiences, and premium sponsorships, tailored to each market.

Join us if you're excited to shape global campaigns, craft stories that connect with people everywhere, and bring top brands to life through unforgettable immersive experiences.

**The role**

As our Head of Brand Partnerships for Middle East and Africa based in our Dubai office, you will play a pivotal role in growing Brand Partnerships across the MEA region. Leveraging an established market position, you will build long-term relationships with top brands, media agencies, and strategic partners.  
Reporting to the Global Head of Brand Partnerships, you will collaborate closely with global functions including Media, Strategy, Creative Solutions, Production, Finance, Data & Insights, Legal, Marketing, and Operations to develop and execute scalable brand partnership opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the company's presence across the Middle East and Africa.

#### **What you'll do**

* Closing high-value sponsorships and media partnerships with leading brands.
* Securing multi-year partnerships for major Originals and premium events.
* Elevating the company's position as the premier experiential-media platform in Iberia.
* Building robust, insight-driven sales strategies and exceeding revenue goals.
* Maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities that drive year-over-year growth.
* Develop and maintain senior decision-maker relationships across brands, agencies, and sponsorship consultancies.
* Proactively secure and negotiate partnerships leveraging media, experiential, and data capabilities.
* Lead MEA revenue targets, forecasting pipeline health and conversion rates.
* Collaborate internally to create and execute high-impact branded activations, media packages, and content integrations.
* Analyze market trends and audience insights to craft tailored commercial strategies.
* Represent the Middle East and Africa in global strategy alignment, ensuring local insights influence cross-market offerings.
* Lead client meetings, negotiations, and presentations with confidence and strategic insight.
* Mentor and develop a high-performing Brand Partnerships team in the MEA region.
* Track and report on performance metrics, ensuring accountability and continuous optimization.

#### **Who you are**

Experience & Expertise

* 15+ years in partnerships, media sales, sponsorship, or experiential marketing.
* Proven track record of securing scaled partnership deals with top-tier brands and agencies.
* Strong network across Middle East and Africa brand and agency ecosystems.

Skills & Abilities

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and consultative selling skills.
* Experience leading commercial teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to structure win-win partnerships.
* Data-driven mindset, comfortable using insights for strategy and storytelling.
* Fluent in English; Arabic a plus but not essential.

#### **Why you'll love it here**

* Attractive compensation package, including stock options to reward your contributions and growth.
* Opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* Professional and personal growth from day one with real responsibility.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Private health insurance with Allianz-Orient: 100% covered by Fever.
* Air ticket: 2100 AED payment for each year of service.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

  

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
